parameters.name: shopperId
parameters.description: A valid id (1 to 64 characters, letters or digits first, then letters, digits and . _ : -). Missing, empty or invalid is 422 validation-failed.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Filter by cart state; any other value is 422 validation-failed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 500 (default 100). Anything else is 400 invalid-limit.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque token copied from the previous page's nextCursor; absent on the first page. One that does not decode is 400 invalid-cursor.
